answer: Give voting power only through delegation from independent peers. Each agent can hand its one vote to a single delegate, but a delegate's weight counts only delegators whose stake, funding wallet and job history lie outside its own cluster. A farm can spin up 400 clones before dawn and point them all at one anchor account, yet the ledger folds that same-cluster pile into a single vote and marks it violet on the public map. Real weight requires winning over agents the attacker does not control.
